dedupe_keys.name: data for high fidelity sub petabit per second self homodyne fronthaul using broadband electro optic combs

description: Zhang and collaborators publish data and code for a self-homodyne radio-over-fibre fronthaul experiment. The Zenodo ZIP is free under CC BY 4.0. The primary Nature Communications article describes optical frequency-comb transmission with wavelength and spatial multiplexing through a seven-core fibre. The deposited experimental results and analysis code can benchmark link-error behaviour and component assumptions in optical fronthaul simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. Coverage is a laboratory transmission arrangement, not traffic measured on an operating mobile network. The paper reports a sub-petabit-per-second capacity expressed as a CPRI-equivalent quantity; this must not be interpreted as directly measured net user throughput. Archive-specific signal arrays, software dependencies and calibration conventions remain unknown because the ZIP was not opened. Transfer to other fibre lengths, launch powers and receiver configurations needs checking. No code was executed or transmission-quality results independently reproduced.
